question: Directional cross-study discovery after analytic selection with dependent observations
primary_target: At least r distinct comparable study environments have a positive (or negative) effect; opposite directions are separate hypotheses
primary_candidate: Monte Carlo max-T pipeline calibration followed by directional Bonferroni partial conjunction and BY
candidate_scope: known Gaussian pipeline covariance; fixed candidate specifications with comparable estimands
validation_rule: No automatic use of sealed real expression files. Synthetic validation uses separately seeded runs; it is not independent external research validation.

acceptance.scientific_claim: Requires a nontrivial advance beyond nearest methods, assumption-specific justification and external validation; software tests alone cannot pass this gate
acceptance.simulation: Report signed-hypothesis FDP, power, Monte Carlo uncertainty, paired power differences, failure cases and all scenarios
acceptance.real_data: No patient-level predictions; report observational associations only; no FDR-truth claims on unknown biological truth
acceptance.holdout: Metadata inspection allowed for eligibility; expression values remain sealed until a versioned analysis plan and disjoint study-family checks exist
acceptance.writing: Research records and technical derivations allowed; paper drafting and submission await user involvement
